newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria adopts insurance law -- state agency.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria adopts insurance law -- state agency.

text.p: Bulgaria's parliament adopted on Thursday a long-awaited insurance law in a bid to regulate its insurance market, the state agency BTA said.
Under the law, Bulgaria's 20-odd insurance companies are expected to register in the newly formed Insurance Supervision Directorate within 15 days after the law is enacted.
Minimum capital requirement for life insurance companies would rise to 200 million levs, property insurance companies to 300 million levs and reinsurance firms to 400 million levs.
Existing insurance companies are expected to collect the required capital in three years in equal annual installments.
Life insurers would also be banned from providing other kinds of insurance and vice versa.
